'''Xinyi Yuan''' ({{lang-zh|c=袁新意}}; born 1981) is a Chinese mathematician who is currently a professor of [[mathematics]] at [[Peking University]] working in [[number theory]], [[arithmetic geometry]], and [[automorphic form]]s.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Xinyi Yuan|url=https://math.berkeley.edu/~yxy/|access-date=2020-11-14|website=math.berkeley.edu}}</ref> In particular, his work focuses on arithmetic intersection theory, [[algebraic dynamics]], [[Diophantine equation]]s and special values of [[L-functions]].

==Early life and education==
Yuan is from [[Macheng]], [[Huanggang]], [[Hubei]] province, and graduated from [[Huanggang Middle School]] in 2000.<ref>{{cite news|url=http://news.xinhuanet.com/yuqing/2015-04/06/c_127660386_5.htm|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170803214413/http://news.xinhuanet.com/yuqing/2015-04/06/c_127660386_5.htm|url-status=dead|archive-date=August 3, 2017|script-title=zh:黄冈中学近14年来未出省状元 发展过程中矛盾凸显|agency=Xinhua News Agency|date=6 April 2015|access-date=3 August 2017}}</ref> That year, he received a gold medal at the [[International Mathematical Olympiad]] while representing [[China]].<ref>[https://www.imo-official.org/participant_r.aspx?id=5973 "Xinyi Yuan – Official IMO Results"], ''[[International Mathematical Olympiad]]''. Retrieved on 4 December 2016.</ref> Yuan obtained his A.B. in mathematics from [[Peking University]] in 2003 and his Ph.D. in mathematics from the [[Columbia University]] in 2008 under the direction of [[Shou-Wu Zhang]].<ref>[https://math.berkeley.edu/~yxy/cv.pdf "Xinyi Yuan CV"], ''[[UC Berkeley]]''. Retrieved on 3 December 2016.</ref> His article "Big Line Bundles over Arithmetic Varieties," published in [[Inventiones Mathematicae]], demonstrates a natural sufficient condition for when the [[Group action (mathematics)#Orbits and stabilizers|orbit]] under the [[absolute Galois group]] is equidistributed.{{sfn|Yuan|2008}}

==Career==
He spent time at the [[Institute for Advanced Study]], [[Princeton University]], and [[Harvard University]] before joining the [[University of California, Berkeley|Berkeley]] faculty in 2012.<ref>[https://www.ias.edu/scholars/xinyi-yuan "IAS Member – Xinyi Yuan"], ''[[Institute for Advanced Study]]''. Retrieved on 4 December 2016.</ref>

Yuan was appointed a [[Clay Research Fellow]] for a three-year term from 2008 to 2013.<ref>[http://www.claymath.org/people/xinyi-yuan "Xinyi Yuan"], ''[[Clay Mathematics Institute]]''. Retrieved on 3 December 2016.</ref> Together with a number of other collaborators, Yuan was profiled in [[Quanta Magazine]] and [[Business Insider]] for, among other things, his research on L-functions.<ref>[https://www.quantamagazine.org/20151208-four-mathematicians/ "Math Quartet Joins Forces on Unified Theory"], ''[[Quanta Magazine]]''. Retrieved on 3 December 2016.</ref><ref>[http://www.businessinsider.com/math-quartet-joins-forces-on-unified-theory-2016-2 "Math Quartet Joins Forces on Unified Theory"], ''[[Business Insider]]''. Retrieved on 4 December 2016.</ref>

Yuan left UC Berkeley to become a full professor at [[Peking University]] in 2020.<ref>{{cite web | url=https://math.berkeley.edu/people/faculty/xinyi-yuan | title=Xinyi Yuan &#124; Department of Mathematics at University of California Berkeley }}</ref> In 2025, Yuan was award the ICCM Gold medal at the [[International Congress of Chinese Mathematicians]].<ref>https://iccm.simis.cn/iccm2025/site/awards/medal-of-mathematics/ . Retrieved on 25 May 2026.</ref> He is also an invited speaker at the 2026 [[International Congress of Mathematicians]].<ref>https://www.icm2026.org/event/ac193975-5d24-4628-8c30-ddb23de19a8b/speakers. Retrieved on 25 May 2026.</ref>

==Research==
In his thesis, Yuan generalized the equidistribution theorem of [[Lucien Szpiro]], [[Emmanuel Ullmo]] and Shou-Wu Zhang to the broader framework of adelic line bundles and in particular to algebraic dynamical systems.<ref>{{cite journal|journal=Inventiones |title=Big Line Bundles over Arithmetic Varieties|issue=173 |year=2008|page=603}}</ref> Together with Shou-Wu Zhang, Yuan proved the [[Colmez conjecture|averaged Colmez conjecture]] which was later shown to imply the [[André–Oort conjecture]] for [[Siegel modular form|Siegel modular varieties]] by [[Jacob Tsimerman]].<ref>{{cite journal|journal=Notices of the American Mathematical Society |title=February 2018 |issn=1088-9477 |volume=65 |issue=2 |year=2018 |page=191}}</ref>{{sfn|Yuan|Zhang|2018}}

With Shou-Wu Zhang, Yuan wrote a monograph generalizing the theory of adelic line bundles to quasi-projective varieties.<ref>{{cite journal|journal=Annals of Mathematics Studies|title=Adelic line bundles over quasi-projective varieties|volume=221 |year=2026}}</ref> Yuan subsequently applied these ideas to reprove the uniform [[Bogomolov conjecture]] for curves, thereby obtaining a new proof of [[Mazur's Conjecture B]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Arithmetic bigness and a uniform Bogomolov-type result|year=2021|url=https://arxiv.org/abs/2108.05625}}</ref> Later, in collaboration with Jiawei Yu and Shengxuan Zhou, he derived the first explicit uniform estimate for the number of rational points on curves of genus at least two in terms only of the Jacobian rank.<ref>{{cite web|title=Quantitavity on the number of rational points in the Mordell conjecture|year=2026|url=https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.01820}}</ref>

Yuan has also made major contributions to Diophantine geometry over function fields through joint work with Junyi Xie. Their results include proofs of the geometric Bogomolov conjecture in arbitrary characteristic <ref>{{cite journal|journal=Inventiones |title=Geometric Bogomolov conjecture in arbitrary characteristics|issue=229|year=2022|pages=607–637}}</ref> and the geometric Bombieri-Lang conjecture for ramified covers of abelian varieties.<ref>{{cite web|title= The Geometric Bombieri-Lang Conjecture for Ramified Covers of Abelian Varieties|year=2023|url=https://arxiv.org/abs/2308.08117}}</ref>
